transitions.label: Session start
transitions.evidence: Session YAML supplies April 13; u0002–u0010 explicitly describe sunset and preparations for dinner.

transitions.label: Rest before an early departure
transitions.evidence: u0836 says it is getting late; u0864 proposes resting and u0867 allows long-rest recovery. The actual next morning at u0943 confirms the overnight transition; logistics in between do not add another day.
transitions.sourceText: Shall we rest and get an early start in the morning.

transitions.label: First travel morning
transitions.evidence: u0943: gather together in the morning; u0944–u0957 introduce the axebeak, mount Vola, and depart. Date inferred as the next day from the YAML anchor.
transitions.sourceText: Us, we start to gather ourselves together in the morning.

transitions.label: First travel day: midday
transitions.evidence: u1012 explicitly advances to around midday before compressing the rest of the day into evening.
transitions.sourceText: around midday. The, the heat of the sun. You see the raven soaring overhead again and then as evening progresses, you've now reached the sort of burned area.

transitions.label: Camp in the burned landscape
transitions.evidence: The latter part of u1012 says evening progresses; u1013 and u1030–u1031 place camp that night. The interrupted next-day lead-in at u1033 is followed by the scouting report and resumes at u1058; it does not add a separate day.
transitions.sourceText: As you start to set your camp. And so there's less less good foraging

transitions.label: Second travel morning
transitions.evidence: u1058 explicitly says the next morning; u1061 describes cool morning fog, and u1076–u1083 describe breakfast. A delayed private message at u1075 does not supply an additional date change.

transitions.label: Arrival at the storm outskirts
transitions.evidence: u1112 calls this late afternoon; u1162 and u1250 refine it to about two or three in the afternoon. Entry is declared at u1339–u1349 after preparations.

transitions.label: Arrival in the calm eye
transitions.evidence: u1652–u1653 estimate roughly 1½–2 hours in the storm; u1738 describes evening sunlight, then late-afternoon sun. Exact clock time remains approximate.
transitions.sourceText: I mean behind you, but where you're standing here is like dead calm. You can see above you, that the evening sunlight late afternoon sun.

transitions.label: Tower scouting has taken 20–30 minutes
transitions.evidence: u2044 estimates the elapsed time of Delwath's scouting; it does not establish a new date or an exact clock time.

transitions.label: Short rest at sunset
transitions.evidence: u2391 requests a short rest. u2432–u2433 and u2446–u2453 describe resting, meditation, sunset, and emerging stars. The reference to 12:30 at u2432 is the real-world stopping time, not in-world time.
